svg.title: G03 One segment sheet
svg.text: G03 One segment sheet (NP1-201 Rev C): 0.35 mm thin, cut by laser
Drawn to scale from the frozen design. 205 sheets glued together make one segment; 45 segments make the stator.
the slot wedge slides in here
Burr max 0.02 mm, all burrs on the same side.
Never anneal (it burns off the glue layer).
